key_insight: P^3-WAM unifies perception, future prediction, and action planning into a single world action model for egocentric dexterous manipulation. It can reconstruct past motion, simulate action-conditioned futures, and generate goal-directed actions with their expected visual outcomes.
problem_solved: The paper addresses the lack of a unified model that can both understand and act in egocentric hand-object manipulation settings. Existing systems often separate perception, prediction, and planning, making dexterous manipulation less coherent and less adaptable.
method: Perceive: reconstructs articulated hand motion and camera trajectories from egocentric video.
Predict: generates visual futures conditioned on prescribed actions.
Plan: jointly produces action trajectories and anticipated visual consequences from an initial image and goal-conditioned input.
impact: This framework helps practitioners build agents that better understand hand-object interactions and reason about the consequences of actions before executing them. It is especially relevant for robotics, embodied AI, and manipulation planning where perception and control must work together.

paper_title: Perceive, Predict, and Plan: a Unified World Action Model for Egocentric Dexterous Manipulation
paper_authors: Zirui Wu, Chen Guo, Tianjian Jiang, Zeren Jiang, Zeming Li
